vertebrae.datasets.base
=======================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.datasets.base

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Dataset abstraction for benchmark inputs.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.datasets.base.BenchmarkDataset


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: BenchmarkDataset

   A labeled dataset prepared for feature extraction or scoring.

   .. attribute:: X

      Input samples, tabular frame, image paths, or embedding matrix.

   .. attribute:: y

      One-dimensional label array.

   .. attribute:: modality

      Dataset modality such as `"text"`, `"tabular"`, or `"embeddings"`.

   .. attribute:: input_col

      Source dataframe input column or columns.

   .. attribute:: label_col

      Source dataframe label column.

   .. attribute:: metadata

      User and construction metadata.


   .. py:method:: from_arrays(X, y, modality, metadata = None)
      :classmethod:


      Create a dataset from array-like inputs and labels.

      :param X: Input samples or feature matrix.
      :param y: Class labels.
      :param modality: Dataset modality.
      :param metadata: Optional metadata to preserve.

      :returns: Validated benchmark dataset.



   .. py:method:: from_dataframe(df, input_col, label_col, modality, metadata = None)
      :classmethod:


      Create a dataset from a pandas DataFrame.

      :param df: DataFrame containing inputs and labels.
      :param input_col: Input column name or list of tabular feature columns.
      :param label_col: Label column name.
      :param modality: Dataset modality.
      :param metadata: Optional metadata to preserve.

      :returns: Validated benchmark dataset.

      :raises ValueError: If requested columns are missing.



   .. py:method:: from_image_paths(paths, labels, metadata = None)
      :classmethod:


      Create an image dataset from filesystem paths.

      :param paths: Image file paths.
      :param labels: Class labels.
      :param metadata: Optional metadata to preserve.

      :returns: Validated image dataset.



   .. py:method:: from_embeddings(embeddings, labels, metadata = None)
      :classmethod:


      Create a dataset from precomputed dense or sparse embeddings.

      :param embeddings: Dense array or scipy sparse embedding matrix.
      :param labels: Class labels.
      :param metadata: Optional metadata to preserve.

      :returns: Validated embedding dataset.



   .. py:method:: validate()

      Validate dataset shape and labels.

      :raises ValueError: If sample counts mismatch, labels are missing, too few
          classes are present, or a class has fewer than two samples.



   .. py:method:: class_counts()

      Count samples per class.

      :returns: Mapping from original label values to sample counts.



   .. py:method:: iter_batches(batch_size, shard = None)

      Yield deterministic sample batches for embedding.

      :param batch_size: Maximum samples per batch.
      :param shard: Optional non-overlapping shard assignment.

      :Yields: Sample batches with original dataset indices and sliced inputs.

      :raises ValueError: If `batch_size` is less than one.



   .. py:method:: stratified_subsample_indices(rate, random_state = 42, min_samples_per_class = 2)

      Select class-stratified sample indices without replacement.

      :param rate: Fraction of each class to keep. Must be in `(0, 1]`.
      :param random_state: Random seed for reproducible selection.
      :param min_samples_per_class: Minimum retained samples per class when possible.

      :returns: Sorted original sample indices for the stratified subset.

      :raises ValueError: If `rate` is outside `(0, 1]`.



   .. py:method:: subset(indices, metadata = None)

      Create a dataset subset by original sample indices.

      :param indices: Sample indices to retain.
      :param metadata: Additional metadata to merge into the subset.

      :returns: Validated dataset containing only the selected samples.



   .. py:method:: summary()

      Summarize the dataset for result metadata and reports.

      :returns: JSON-compatible dataset summary.



   .. py:method:: fingerprint()

      Compute a conservative dataset fingerprint for caching.

      :returns: Stable hash string derived from inputs, labels, modality, and metadata.
